name: Artistlab Order Review Request for WooCommerce
author: artistlab

sections.description:
Order Review Request Lite automatically sends review request emails to your customers after their WooCommerce orders are completed. It’s fully compatible with any WooCommerce store and supports any review link, including TrustPilot, Google, FeeFoo, and more.

Lite Version Features:
* Automatically send review request emails after order completion.
* Skip refunded, cancelled, or pending orders.
* Fully compatible with any WooCommerce store.
* Any review link i.e. TrustPilot, Google, FeeFoo.

Pro Version (coming soon) Features:
* Customize the email template fully (HTML & variables).
* Skip sending emails for specific orders or customers.
* Send multiple review requests per customer.
* Flexible scheduling: days after order, recurring monthly.
* Reporting and analytics of sent emails.

Usage

After installation and configuration:

  1. When an order is marked as completed, the plugin will automatically schedule a review email.
  2. Orders that are refunded, cancelled, or pending will not trigger emails.
  3. Customers will receive a simple email with a link to leave a review on your chosen platform.

Example Review Links:
* TrustPilot: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/yourdomain.com
* Google: https://g.page/yourbusiness/review
* FeeFoo: https://www.feefo.com/en-gb/reviews/yourbusiness

License

sections.installation:
1. Upload the order-review-request-lite folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Review Requests to configure your settings.
  4. Enter your Review URL (TrustPilot, Google, FeeFoo, etc.).
  5. Set the number of days after order completion to send the email.
sections.faq:
Can I customize the email template in the Lite version?

No, the Lite version uses a default email template. Customization and advanced features are coming in the Pro version.

Can I send multiple review requests to the same customer?

No, the Lite version only sends one review request per completed order. The Pro version will allow multiple requests.

Will this plugin work with any WooCommerce store?

Yes, it is fully compatible with WooCommerce out-of-the-box.
